paragraphs: FLASHNET sells inteliLIGHT, a remote management system for street lighting made up of lamp controllers and software. The customers it names are city managers, street lighting operators and lamp manufacturers around the world.

Controllers are built for both individual lamp and lighting segment control. City examples on the home page run over NB-IoT and cellular communications. The company page puts energy savings at up to 35 percent through smart dimming scheduling, with overall operational costs down by up to 42 percent. The system is presented as compatible with major smart city standards.

FLASHNET is a technology company based in Brasov, Romania, that combines hardware and software into services for cities. It says that since 2005 more than 400 million people have seen the benefits of inteliLIGHT, in hundreds of cities on six continents. The company has been part of Lucy Group since 2022.
